game.title: Alice: Madness Returns
game.blurb: Dark third-person action-adventure in which Alice returns to a twisted Wonderland, from Spicy Horse (published by Electronic Arts), released 2011-06-14. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Fandom page names, as there is no Steam achievement list.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "Alice: Madness Returns" or "Alice Madness Returns" (API returned missing). alice.fandom.com answers the API, with about 159 linked pages, including the realm pages "Vale of Tears", "Hatter's Domain", "Deluded Depths", "Oriental Grove", "Queensland", "Dollhouse" and "Londerland", and the London places "Houndsditch Home for Wayward Youth", "Hyde Park" and "Moorgate Station"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 19680 is in the store list but its achievement schema comes back empty and the global percentages call is refused (HTTP 403), so steam=None. Chapter order follows the order in which these realm pages are linked on the Fandom game page; it was not checked against the game. RAWG lists a playtime of only 3 hours, which looks low.
